card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 89 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 20.3 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RY Sco: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 88.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,088 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RY Sco: Per, Rad, Dist
